---
name: Reproducible verification bug
about: Report an unexpected result in the supported public checker
title: "[Verification] "
---

## Public version and environment
Commit or URL, Node.js version and operating system.

## Steps to reproduce
Exact command and smallest synthetic input. Was the original reference preserved?

## Expected result
Explain the documented behaviour you expected. A changed record returning exit code 1 is expected.

## Observed result
Output and exit code; remove local usernames and private paths.

## Sharing check
- [ ] The example is invented and contains no private documents, personal information or secrets.

For a suspected vulnerability, contact the maintainer through the profile linked in the README to agree a private reporting route before disclosing sensitive details.
